work_completed: Diagnosed why HAIEF wasn't deploying on Cloudflare: Jekyll site configured for GitHub Pages (baseurl /haief), no CF build/deploy config, a conflicting Gemfile (jekyll 4.3 + github-pages), and a stale orphaned 'haief' Worker (last modified 2026-02-25).

Migrated the site from Jekyll to Astro (mirrors neurolift-blog): package.json/astro.config/tsconfig; _layouts/default.html → src/layouts/Base.astro; _includes → src/components/Header.astro + Footer.astro; assets → public/.

Converted index.html → src/pages/index.astro and all 11 _pages/*.md → src/pages/*.md, substituting Jekyll Liquid (site.social.*, relative_url, site.url/baseurl) with resolved values; baseurl fixed to root domain; 0 leftover Liquid.
Removed the dead Jekyll scaffold (_config.yml, Gemfile, _layouts, _includes, _pages, index.html, azure-pipelines.yml, root assets/robots/404).
Built (astro build → 13 pages + sitemap) and deployed to Cloudflare Pages.
LIVE: https://haief-site.pages.dev (verified homepage, /the-problem/, case study; CSS 200; no leftover Liquid).
decisions_made: Switched stack Jekyll → Astro because Ruby/Jekyll can't be built in this environment (no passwordless sudo); Astro is Node-native, Cloudflare-native, and matches neurolift-blog.
Deployed via Cloudflare Pages as project 'haief-site' (not 'haief') because the existing 'haief' Worker collides with that name in the unified Workers/Pages namespace.
Set site to https://haief.org (Joshua's chosen domain) and removed the /haief baseurl for root-domain hosting.
decisions_pending: Custom domain haief.org: register it, add the zone to this Cloudflare account, then bind it to the haief-site Pages project (dashboard / registrar — cannot be done from here).
Whether to retire the stale 'haief' Worker.
Reconcile the foundation URL: repo/governance + the neurolift-technologies surface reference elevaitionfoundation.org, not haief.org.
escalations: Domain registration + custom-domain binding require registrar access and the Cloudflare dashboard — Joshua's action (OTOI §4.4).
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: Site is live at haief-site.pages.dev; redeploy with `npm run deploy` (astro build + wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name haief-site) — toolchain: Node ~/.local/node/bin, wrangler OAuth-authed. To go live on haief.org: register domain → add CF zone → Pages project haief-site → Custom domains → add haief.org. Also update the neurolift-technologies proof generator: it references haief/_pages/case-study-anthropic-pentagon-2026.md, now at src/pages/.
